name: WorldSphereMod3D
description:
Hard fork of WorldSphereMod that finishes the 3D conversion: voxelized actors/items, procedural building meshes, crossed-quad foliage, mesh water, directional sun + cascaded shadows, skeletal animation, worldspace UI. Co-installable with upstream WorldSphereMod.

Features:
- Voxelized 3D actors with GPU instancing
- Procedural building mesh generation
- Forward+ renderer with shadow cascades
- Worldspace UI (health bars, nameplates, damage popups)
- BridgeServer IPC for external tools
- 611+ automated tests

Note: If the icon is red, your hardware lacks compute shader / GPU instancing support.
